title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES DECLARING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE ENVIRONMENTAL AND ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM WITHIN LAGUNA LAKE AS A PRESIDENTIAL PRIORITY

text.en:
Execution. The River Basin Control Office (RBCO) under
the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) shall be the lead
agency in the implementation of the Program.

Implementation Arrangement. The RBCO shall be
supported by the Laguna Lake Development Authority (LLDA), an agency under
the DENR. All other departments, government agencies and entities concerned
are hereby ordered to provide full cooperation for the timely and smooth
execution of the Program.

Program Components. The components of the Program
shall include:
a. The rehabilitation of the Laguna Lake system, specifically the
rehabilitation and dredging of Laquna Lake as well as lakeshore
reclamation and surface management, improvement of water quality
and managements systems, and management of resource use such as
for fish production, water supply and the like.
b. The development of transport systems, which may include
development of Laguna Lake ferry systems and Laguna Lake ports and
marinas development, which shall be in support of the Government's
Nautical Highways Program.
c. Other related components that may be deemed important in the
implementation of the foregoing components.
The RBCO, in coordination with concerned government agencies, shall
submit to the President the integrated plan within sixty (60) days after the
effectivity of this order.

Budgetary Support. The RBCO shall have an initial
funding of Five Hundred Million Pesos (P 500,000,000.00) to be sourced from
unprogrammed funds of the DENR, and/or as may be recommended and/or
approved by the Department of Budget and Management (DBM). The initial
funds shall be used for the planning, operations and administration of RBCO to
carry out the implementation of the Program. Starting budgetary year 2010, its
operating budget shall be incorporated in the budgetary allocation of the DENR
and member-agencies.

Inter-Agency Cooperation. The departments, bureaus,
offices, agencies or instrumentalities, including government-owned or controlled
corporations, are hereby directed to extend such assistance and cooperation as
the RBCO may need in the discharge of its functions.

Repeal. All executive orders, rules and regulations and
other issuances or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive
Order, are hereby revoked, amended, or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect fifteen
(15) days after its complete publication in a national newspaper of general
circulation and fifteen (15) days after registration with the Office of the National
Administrative Register.
DONE in the City of Manila, this the day of July
of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Nine.
glini A. Away
By the President:
